title: Tkaczuk 1968 lumbar PLL full-width segment yield load

quantity.name: yield load
quantity.definition: load at yield point of full-width ligament segment clamped over 10 mm (no bony attachments)

source.n: 74 lumbar spines (autopsy, 1 day-92 y), 484 ALL/PLL samples overall; failure tests: 14 full-width segments from 3 spines (Table VII) and 26 standard strips from 3 spines (Table VIII)
source.sample: human lumbar anterior and posterior longitudinal ligaments, autopsy

protocol.summary: Full-dimension ligament segments (vertebral-body or disc level) clamped directly with 10 mm clamp distance, loaded to tearing; high-humidity chamber; loading rate 0.5-50 mm/min, most tests 5 mm/min (Alwetron machine, 50 kg load cell). Yield load = load at yield point; failure load = load at tear. Samples slipping or tearing at clamps rejected (14 of 22 retained).
how_to_simulate: Model a full-width ALL or PLL segment clamped over 10 mm length (no bone)

extraction.check_notes: Tables read from 150-dpi page renders (OCR matched). Loads converted kg -> N (x9.80665); original in 'orig'. Mean/SD computed by extractor. Clamped ligament (no bone) - not pooled with bone-ligament-bone failure forces.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
